Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

BuildProjectFile.description: Path to the build project (.csproj) relative to the repository root. Defaults to 'build/_build.csproj' when unset. Read by the Fallout global tool's in-tool runner.

AgilityChannel.description: Agility SDK channel: Stable (default) or Preview

AgilitySdkRoot.description: Restored Microsoft.Direct3D.D3D12 package directory containing the selected Agility SDK

BenchmarkBudgetShare.description: Include median share of 8.333 ms for explicitly SteadyState cases only (not frame latency)

BenchmarkCategory.description: Optional BenchmarkDotNet category filter across selected projects

BenchmarkFilter.description: BenchmarkDotNet method filter for selected projects

BenchmarkList.description: Enumerate compiled Benchmark cases without running timings

BenchmarkMode.description: Benchmark execution mode: screen, compare, or diagnose. Required unless listing

BenchmarkProject.description: Target project glob, for example Lumyte.Mathematics or Lumyte.*.Benchmark

BenchmarkTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline seconds, up to 900: shared for BenchmarkCore; per build/catalog/Type.Method partition for BenchmarkCoreEvaluate

Cache.description: Emscripten cache from the .NET wasm-tools workload

Cargo.description: Cargo executable override; specify Rustc as well to use an existing compiler directly

Configuration.description: Build configuration shared by repository targets

DotnetPath.description: Explicit dotnet executable for child build commands

Emsdk.description: Emscripten SDK tools directory from the .NET wasm-tools workload

GalleryRepository.description: Repository whose successful diagnostic gallery artifacts are collected

HostOnly.description: Build and package only projects supported by the current host OS

NoBuild.description: Skip compilation and use existing outputs

Node.description: Node.js executable from the .NET wasm-tools workload

Output.description: Output directory for native libraries and Cargo intermediates

Project.description: Optional project for restore, compile, test, pack or publish

Python.description: Explicit Python executable; otherwise a private verified runtime is provisioned

PythonPathFile.description: File receiving the resolved private Python executable for MSBuild

RepositoryRoot.description: Repository root when an isolated native worker uses a separate Fallout state directory

Rustc.description: Rustc executable override paired with Cargo

Rustup.description: Rustup executable override for explicit setup targets

ScreeningAll.description: Select all twelve representative cases, including A/A

ScreeningBase.description: Exact base revision for advisory screening

ScreeningBaseDirectory.description: Optional read-only base checkout; HEAD must match the plan

ScreeningHead.description: Exact head revision for advisory screening

ScreeningHeadDirectory.description: Optional read-only head checkout; HEAD must match the plan

ScreeningTimeoutSeconds.description: Total screening deadline in seconds, capped at 900

SkipParleyPackage.description: Exclude Parley packaging until native assets from all supported RIDs have been collected

Solution.description: Solution to restore, compile and test
